evidence: Figure 6.1 shows a box labelled "Workload metrics rps · token profile · concurrency". Its caption states: "Figure-art note: the third printed entry in the workload box (concurrency) is an erratum in the figure art for the offered request rate λ; it is not a workload metric."
issue: Figure 6.1's workload box still lists "concurrency" as a workload metric, directly contradicting §6.1.1 (page 121), which states "Concurrency is not a workload input: it is a serving-side quantity derived from the arrival rate and the time in system (Little's law), so it belongs with queue depth on the scheduler side, not in this layer." The caption acknowledges the error rather than fixing the art, so the figure continues to teach the wrong classification at a glance.
